attributes.action: Recognise Profound Autism as a Distinct Diagnostic Classification in the UK
attributes.additional_details: Autism is a spectrum, but support needs vary greatly. Profoundly autistic people may be non-speaking, have developmental disabilities, lack danger awareness and require constant supervision and lifelong personal care. Families often struggle to access suitable education, healthcare and support. Recognising Profound Autism as a distinct diagnosis could improve understanding of these complex needs. This is not about dividing the autistic community, but ensuring nobody is overlooked.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to formally recognise Profound Autism as a distinct diagnosis within the autism spectrum, acknowledging the complex communication, developmental, personal care and lifelong support needs of those affected, ensuring they receive appropriate recognition and support.

rejection.details:
We have a petition open which we think mirrors in part what you are asking for, and which you may wish to sign:

Require NHS autism diagnoses to include assessment of level of support needed: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770800
